profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
•       Passionate software development professional bringing more than 14 years experience in software 
        design, architecture, development, and production support. 
•       Fluent in Ruby on Rails and React.
•       Advanced knowledge of full-stack web development and working with internal and external APIs.  
•       Self-directed and motivated software engineer who works effectively in a dynamic environment.
•       Expertise in all aspects of the software development life cycle, including requirements analysis, 
         design, development and production support. 
•       Skilled at developing complex solutions possessing strong creative thinking skills, high energy and 
         integrity. 
•       Well-versed in creating test cases, as well as covering all test conditions and eliminating 
         redundancy. Precisely executes development projects from concept to delivery.

        Analytics to provide clients with real-time analytics data.
•	Rapidly prototyped new capabilities for Freemium platform to confirm feasibility.
•       Hot fixed high priority bugs for strategic clients

•	Researched, designed and implemented full-stack custom reporting feature for information 
         identification, extraction, and indexing.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
•	Individually architected and developed UEFI OROM boot driver for PCIe Enterprise solid state drive.  
•	Developed POC internal bring up Windows driver for Intel’s first PCIe SSD allowing early phase testing and development of firmware.  Driver used as model for release version of the product driver.
•	Extensive development and debug experience in the area of UEFI drivers and SSD FW.  Also Windows drivers (WDM and WDF).  Work included optimization of performance as well as functionality, such as fixing of data integrity bugs. 
•	Specifically requested by S.K. Ramesh, the Dean of the College of Engineering and Computer Science at Cal State Northridge, to attend the Tech Fest to recruit graduates for Intel.
•	Extensive knowledge of SW lifecycle.  
•	Composed and Published the Software Architecture Specification and Product Requirements Documentation for UEFI PCIe boot driver.  Peer reviewed spec with organization to achieve alignment.  
•	As FW developer was chosen to travel to validation site to work closely with validation engineers to drive closure on bugs and drive Intel 320 series SSD development to Beta.  Expedited closure of blocker and critical bugs effectively left shifting schedule approximately 3 weeks 
•	Implemented WBEM infrastructure for PCIe Enterprise SSD enabling remote access and configuration capability.
•	Key contributor to the firmware development of 320 series SSD and Intel/Hitachi Ultrastar SSD400S.   
•	Performed competitive analysis and optimized SATA Windows storage driver to increase performance by removing inefficiency in driver stack IO path.  Analyzed performance metrics, such as sequential/random reads/writes per second.  Provided approximately 42% overall performance boost for all I/O.   
•	Designed and developed features of FW test tools in both the GUI application layer, written in Python, as well as in driver space, written in C

projects.title: Ruby on Rails Project Management Site
projects.description: As part of the course project for Foundations of Software Engineering, we were charged with creating a project management portal from the ground up using such technologies as Ruby on Rails, JavaScript, jQuery, and Bootstrap. In order to complete this activity, the agile process of extreme programming was utilized. Our team designed the user stories, look and feel of the site, and iterations surrounding each release. Additionally, we met weekly with our customer to verify prioritization and development activities. The project was a huge success in that our team was able to successfully produce and demonstrate a fully functional website built with Ruby on Rails that met all of our customers' needs.
